selector.rationale: The presence of superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils and erythematous annular plaques without scale are highly supportive of Eosinophilic annular erythema (EAE).

rejected.label: Pembrolizumab-induced rash
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings unique to pembrolizumab

rejected.label: Eosinophilic cellulitis
rejected.why: Cellulitis typically presents with more severe inflammation and systemic symptoms, which are not described in the vignette

rejected.label: Immune-related adverse event (irAE) of immunotherapy
rejected.why: Too broad, as it encompasses many possible immune-related adverse events without specific findings pointing to this diagnosis over EAE

rejected.label: Ipilimumab-induced dermatitis
rejected.why: Similar to pembrolizumab-induced rash, lacks specific findings unique to ipilimumab
